system.text:
Claustrophobia is a specific phobia applying to enclosed spaces. A character afflicted with this trait will not willingly enter small spaces like prison cells, closets, tunnels, trunks or even cramped rooms. If he should find himself in an enclosed space for a long period of time (more than a minute or two), he becomes agitated and eventually hysterical—the character must pass a Steel test. If failed, he must either Swoon or Run and Scream.

Type: Dt (die trait). Cost: 1 pt.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 318
